items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: It was Evelyn Shepherd, Evelyn and her sister -- Evelyn Shepherd, Lena Horne --

ctx.x: Cotton Club was nice. They had beautiful -- now, that's where they had some beautiful girls, at the Cotton Club. Those gangsters in there had nothing else but those beautiful girls, you know, to work there. It was Evelyn Shepherd, Evelyn and her sister -- Evelyn Shepherd, Lena Horne --
Lena Horne -- now, she used to -- when she came out of high school, Lena Horne, I found a picture of her conducting the Noble Sissle Orchestra.
